HISD Textarea

Multi-line form control. It shares the input shell — 1px border at rest, 2px action ring on focus, danger border on error — and adds vertical resize plus a three-row minimum height. The label sits above the control; helper and error text are wired through aria-describedby. Both themes below render every state from the same stylesheet; dark inherits entirely from data-theme="dark".

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Default -->
<div class="hisd-textarea-field">
  <label class="hisd-textarea-label" for="comments">Comments</label>
  <textarea
    class="hisd-textarea-control"
    id="comments"
    name="comments"
    rows="3"
    placeholder="Share your feedback…"
    aria-describedby="comments-help"></textarea>
  <p class="hisd-textarea-message hisd-textarea-helper" id="comments-help">
    Tell us what went well and what we can improve.
  </p>
</div>

<!-- Error: mark the field, flip aria-invalid, point describedby at the message -->
<div class="hisd-textarea-field" data-invalid="true">
  <label class="hisd-textarea-label" for="reason">
    Reason for absence
    <span class="hisd-textarea-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
  </label>
  <textarea
    class="hisd-textarea-control"
    id="reason"
    name="reason"
    rows="3"
    required
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="reason-msg"></textarea>
  <p class="hisd-textarea-message hisd-textarea-error" id="reason-msg" role="alert">
    A reason is required before you can submit.
  </p>
</div>

<!-- Disabled -->
<textarea class="hisd-textarea-control" id="notes" rows="3" disabled></textarea>
